decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the firm's data-driven integration strategy and has a dedicated page, so the option remains valuable and cheap to hold.
The connectivity module is a low-cost software add-on to the installed apron base, and long airport procurement cycles mean its value has not yet resolved.
Equipment monitoring supports the growing service and maintenance business on the installed equipment, so keeping this inexpensive option open is justified.
Resource management complements turnaround software and can be bundled with it, so its uncertain upside outweighs the small cost of maintaining it.
The controller safety alert service extends the tower and traffic control offer, and safety products with long sales cycles need more time before their value can be judged.
